IT Helpdesk: Created ticket #IT-6221 for HubSpot/Gong/Drive. Quick troubleshooting if Okta not received:
```
okta status --email taylor.brooks@redwood.com

gong-cli users:get --email taylor.brooks@redwood.com
```

Access Bot: Access ticket SALES-8124 created and updated: HubSpot: done; Notion: invite resent; Drive: share pending; Gong: pending. Track: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SALES-8124
Samir Patel: I approved the sandbox in 1Password and approved demo access. Lena, can you add Taylor to the shadow call list?
Lena Ruiz: Added you to Live Calls and CS standups. Also pasted the quick cost vs perf script here: "Start with outcomes > ask about current infra costs > explain batching/caching tradeoffs > offer Dedicated for predictable throughput." Copy to your notes.
Taylor Brooks: Notion access finally works, Drive permissions propagated, and Gong invite arrived. Transcripts on, please. Thank you all — excited to get started! :rocket:
